_note: Household surface. No enterprise entity name, seal or document code appears in this file — the binder carries household codes only. There is no revenue field anywhere in this module and there is not meant to be: value reaches this side as an approved distribution, never as revenue. Youth entries carry no location, no schedule, no image and no exportable detail.

sundayRhythm.title: Pre-bulletin prep
sundayRhythm.what: Gather what the week actually produced before anybody writes about it. Nothing goes in the bulletin that was not checked first.

sundayRhythm.title: Bulletin
sundayRhythm.what: One page. What happened, what is next, what is asked of whom. Youth entries carry no location, no schedule and no image.

sundayRhythm.title: Council
sundayRhythm.what: The commands ledger is read, and each carried command is closed, carried once more, or dropped on purpose. Two carried at most.

commandsNote: The council's actual commands are not in this workspace. Four empty rows carry the mechanism so the limit can be exercised; their titles are not invented.

binder.title: The trust instrument
binder.note: Revision and status are not observable from this workspace.

binder.title: Legacy Plan V2
binder.note: Version two is sourced. Its status is not.

binder.title: Bulletin format, including the youth-protection rules
binder.note: The rules in it govern every view in this module that names a minor.

distribution.rule: Value reaches this side only as a distribution the trustee has approved. It does not arrive as revenue, it is not routed here from an operating entity, and this console holds no field for an amount.
distribution.why: Modelling amounts here would make this a place where distributions are decided. They are not decided here; they are recorded here after the fact, and only their approval state.

youth.detail: No address, venue, route or place name in any view, bulletin or export.
No time, day, recurring pattern or absence that lets someone predict where a minor will be.
No photograph, likeness or identifying description.
Nothing containing a youth record leaves this console in any form. The export control is disabled at the component, and the export function refuses as well.
